data.one_liner: Flutter TextField widget that automatically resizes text to fit bounds.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AutoSizeTextField widget that behaves like a standard TextField but automatically resizes its text to fit perfectly within available bounds. It supports minimum and maximum font sizes, step granularity, preset font sizes, and overflow replacements.
use_when: You need a text input field where the font size scales down dynamically to prevent overflow.
You want a drop-in replacement for standard Flutter TextFields with automatic text resizing capabilities.
avoid_when: The text field lacks bounded constraints, which can cause layout issues or overflows.
You require non-standard native text editing features not supported by the underlying TextField wrapper.
strengths: Drop-in replacement for standard TextField widgets.
Highly customizable font sizing options including min/max limits, step granularity, and preset font sizes.
Supports full-width expansion or intrinsic text width sizing.
weaknesses: Requires bounded constraints to function correctly, otherwise text may overflow.
Using an unreasonably high base font size can impact performance.
